scene: The key unlocks three transit gates at the arcade terminus.
picture: Along a tiled floor, a glass cable tram hangs at far left, and a river barge waits by an open dock on the left. The player in lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands at centre holding a brass key. The mechanical pigeon perches on a sign at right, while an open spiral lift waits at far right.
shown: a glass cable tram hanging waiting on rails at far left
a wooden river barge moored at a dock door on the left
a caged brass spiral lift standing open at the far right
